note: Revised from Emerson's (1928) species description, originally in English; the alate and the soldier are described, the worker is not recorded in the original, and for the queen only measurements of body length and abdominal width are given, not treated in a separate section; synonyms, figure numbers, localities and nest records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, oval-rectangular, sides rounded. Antennae 13-segmented, the third segment smallest, almost as long as the second, the fourth wider and longer than the third. Mandibles reddish brown, stout, with coarse and irregular dentation. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly excavated or not excavated at all, the notch sometimes filled by a transparent mass. Head with mandibles 2.89–3.00 mm long, head width 1.10–1.15 mm, antenna length 1.67 mm; pronotum length 0.33 mm, width 0.72–0.75 mm; hind tibia 0.90–1.00 mm; left mandible 1.20 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, slightly rectangular, sides straight and parallel. Fontanelle small, concolorous with the head. The third antennal segment small, the fourth slightly shorter than the second. Compound eyes medium-sized, not protruding, situated near the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather small, separated from the compound eye by less than their own width. Postclypeus paler than the head, with a median line. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, posterior margin incised, its width about equal to the head width including the eyes. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly incised. Head length 1.23 mm, width 1.10 mm; compound eye diameter 0.32 mm; pronotum length 0.60 mm, width 0.99 mm; hind tibia 1.11 mm.
